verdict.rationale: Factory's core workflow lets a developer delegate a plain-language task to Droid, which analyzes the codebase and proposes a scoped diff before applying changes, and Missions explicitly support defining features, milestones, and success criteria before code is written. This directly matches the intent-to-spec story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and explicit detail on bug-report-to-spec conversion (evidence focuses mostly on feature/task delegation).
